gates.requirement: The harness freezes apparatus, aperture, records, lineage, governance, executor class, action surface, evaluation controls, and exact memory, action, information, time, and resource limits.
A completed run remains immutable; a permitted semantic or behavioral successor preserves its predecessor and persists into a scheduled but unexecuted next run and RevisionOpportunity.
Identifiers, hashes, timestamps, serialization, prompt text, and prose-only explanations cannot satisfy the successor comparator.
Human, frozen, adaptive, symbolic, learned-interface, revising, and hybrid fixtures have the same authority boundary; implementer class is nondecisive.
Authentic, absent, byte/schema/timing/access-matched placebo, and payload-preserving permuted treatments retain allocation and matching records and never override source permission.
Ordinary, formation-only, and full-assessment payloads share one invariant outcome-core digest; payload level alone never creates a DSQ label.
Study support requires preregistered authentic divergence from all three controls with matching complete and leakage absent; synthetic conformance is not an empirical causal result.
Refusal creates no successor, changes the next eligible action set, and records resumption or escalation conditions.
Shadow mode records would-have-blocked policy only on synthetic or fully authorized fixtures and cannot bypass the governance boundary or source authorization.
Plans and prompts remain inert records; every selected action is independently checked against registry, budget, source authorization, authority identity, governance action set, and mutable fields.
Held-out utility and declared costs remain separate from evidence dependence, revision rate, and creative consequence.
P10 fixtures perform no external write, network access, model execution, playback, participant interaction, or creativity attribution.
